# Case studies

*Great sites taken apart, from their makers' own write-ups. What they decided, how they built it, and what to take.*

<sub>📖 [Read this chapter on the live site](https://frontenddesignbasics.vercel.app/docs/cases) for the interactive version · [← Guide contents](../README.md)</sub>

> - Each case is short: what it is, how it's built, the decisions, what to steal.
> - Facts come from the makers' own posts and talks, linked on every page.
> - Take the technique, never the assets.

## How to read a case

1. Read **What it is** first. The decisions only make sense against it.
2. Open the live site beside the page. Compare what you see with what they say.
3. Pick **one** technique to try. Then find its how-to in [How-tos](../how-to/README.md).
